mapper.select: /* selectMasterMpSoAgentPoMngList */ SELECT A.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, A.DS_SEQ, A.SEQ, A.PR_NO, A.PR_SEQ, A.AGENT, A.STATUS, A.TYPE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND CODE = A.TYPE) AS TYPE_TEXT, A.NOTICE_DATE, A.RE_PROCESS_TYPE, A.CH_PROCESS_TYPE, A.PARCEL_YN, A.RE_DS_DATE, A.CH_DS_DATE, A.AGENT_REMARK, A.KEP_REMARK, A.ADD_USER_ID, TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, A.CONFIRM_USER_ID, A.CONFIRM_DATE, A.CHANGE_USER_ID, A.CHANGE_DATE, (SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT SPECIFICATION FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS SPECIFICATION, (SELECT MAKER_CODE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS MAKER_CODE, (SELECT MAKER_NAME FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS MAKER_NAME, DECODE(A.DS_SEQ, '000000', (SELECT ITEM_QTY FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'), (SELECT CD_QTY FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND DS_SEQ = A.DS_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') ) AS CD_QTY, (SELECT UNIT_PRICE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS UNIT_PRICE, (SELECT AGENT_PRICE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS AGENT_PRICE FROM KEP_PO_MNG A WHERE 1=1 AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.STATUS = 'S' AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) ORDER BY A.ADD_DATE DESC
